battery version 0.1.25

usage: battery [--chdir dir, -j N] <command>

These are the available commands:
	help <command>   Prints more help about a command.
	build            Build current config.
	config [args]    Configures a build.
	test             Build current config, then run tests.
	toolchain        Manage Volt toolchain.
	version          Display battery version then exit.
	init             Generate a battery.txt file in the current directory.

Normal usecase when standing in a project directory.
	$ battery config path/to/volta path/to/watt .
	$ battery build

The --chdir flag changes the working directory of the battery process
before doing anything else.
The -j flag tells battery how many programs it can run at once. By
default this is the same as the number of processors (cores) installed
in your system.

toolchain_loader_setup: Temporary Clang, GDC and llvm-ar launchers provide library paths when Battery starts children with a reduced environment. The GDC launcher selects the GCC 13 linker plugin and gives the bootstrapped compiler a runtime path for LLVM.
isolation: Ubuntu WSL with networking disabled during compilation and execution. All dependency archives and generated files were staged outside the corpus.

updated_expectation.build_command: Copy hello.volt unchanged to src/main.volt in the recorded temporary project, then run battery config /path/to/Volta /path/to/Watt . and battery -j 4 build
updated_expectation.expected_result: The native Linux executable exits 0 and writes Hello, World! followed by a newline.

toolchain: Volta 03253933 with Watt 0e16aeab, Battery v0.1.25 and LLVM 14
semantic_scope: Volta compiled the unchanged bytes of hello.volt with Watt from a temporary src/main.volt copy. The linked x86-64 Linux executable ran in WSL, printed the exact greeting on stdout and exited 0.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
